batch_size.description: Batch Size for sampling of data by {@link KerasGenerator} for the model of {@link KerasPipe}.

shuffle.description: If true, shuffle the training data.

verbose.description: Verbosity mode. 0 = silent, 1 = progress bar, 2 = one line per epoch.

max_queue_size.description:
Maximum size for the generator queue.

Ignored in tensorflow>3

use_multiprocessing.description:
If True, use process-based threading.

Ignored in tensorflow>3

workers.description: Maximum number of processes to spin up when using process-based threading.

epochs.description: Number of epochs to train the model.

initial_epoch.description: Epoch at which to start training. Defaults to 0 if not specified.

steps_per_epoch.description: Total number of steps (batches of samples) before declaring one epoch finished and starting the next epoch.

title:
Weights to apply to the model's loss for each sample. Should be the same length as the `x` input into
{@link KerasPipe}. This should be passed in to the `y` port when calling {@link #train}.
name: KerasFitArgs
